w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE TERMS OF SERVICE! Lucas joins you!

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Grace just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Zoltan just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: Your pack is full. Eat something, test a lump from your pack, or leave some for the woods.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Mara freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE RERUN! You're on your own.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "WAVE 3. The gate opens again. What comes out has seen the corpses and learned nothing, which is worse."
You don't know what that was. Déjà vu with teeth. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE RERUN! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
📺 SYSTEM: "COMBAT! THE RERUN! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!"

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "You snore in movements. Allegro, adagio, a finale that rattles the set. The judges have never seen anything like it. Neither has anyone."
firstContext: Your stomach is a fist. Eat — anything real, now.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
📺 SYSTEM: "You snore in movements. Allegro, adagio, a finale that rattles the set. The judges have never seen anything like it. Neither has anyone."
📺 SYSTEM: "📈 your showbiz fans +3 — the snore symphony (favor: 7)"
📺 SYSTEM: "🎨 COLOR: It did the thing! Should we be proud? I feel something. Is this pride? Log it."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 2 · Craft 2 · Talk 12 · Explore 28 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
